question: With whom should kula practitioners avoid dwelling according to the cited text?
premises: Some people claim to stand in the kula tradition but remain outside the heroic substances.
Such persons are classed with the bound ones.
The revered Madhava Kula text prohibits dwelling together with them.
inference: Affiliation with the kula tradition is not sufficient if one rejects its heroic substances; association with such persons is forbidden.
uncertainties: The precise identity of the text called śrīmādhava kule is not clear from this verse alone.
plain_english: Those who claim to stand in the kula tradition but remain outside the heroic substances should not be lived with; the revered Madhava Kula says one must not dwell together with such bound ones.
